Name: qmail_list
SQL:
SELECT cust_list.fname, cust_list.pname, cust_list.ct, cust_list.numw AS custn, cust_list.number AS q, IIf(nz([cust_list]![yeda])<>"" And nz([cust_list]![cyeda])="",nz([cust_list]![yeda]),IIf(nz([cust_list]![cyeda])<>"" And nz([cust_list]![yeda])="",nz([cust_list]![cyeda]),nz([cust_list]![yeda]) & '+' & nz([cust_list]![cyeda]))) AS qyeda, cust_list.yeda AS qy, cust_list.cyeda AS qcy, cust_list.area, cust_list.city, cust_list.moadon, cust_list.kupa, cust_list.email, cust_list.sel, cust_list.tel, cust_list.address, cust_list.Min, cust_list.zehut, cust_list.bdate, cust_list.CDate AS mmd, cust_list.chdate AS mad, IIf(nz([colv])="","01/01/1980",[colv]) AS qcolv, cust_list.wsort, cust_list.wsort AS qwsort, Val(nz([ocupation])) AS qocupation, Year([bdate]) AS qyr, IIf(nz([cust_list]![cdate])>nz([cust_list]![chdate]),[cust_list]![cdate],[cust_list]![chdate]) AS rpdate, (nz([address])) & "  " & (nz([area])) AS maddress, Trim$(nz([city]))+"  "+Trim$(nz([mikud])) AS mcity, Trim$(nz([fname]))+"  "+Trim$(nz([pname])) AS name, IIf([swb]=True,[swb],[aswb]) AS qswb, cust_list.numw AS custnum, nz([email]) AS qemail, orders.*, orders.yeda AS oryeda, adchecks.caddate AS dta, checks.chdate AS dtm, checks.ct AS ctc
FROM ((cust_list LEFT JOIN adchecks ON cust_list.numw=adchecks.numw) LEFT JOIN checks ON cust_list.numw=checks.numw) LEFT JOIN orders ON cust_list.numw=orders.numw
WHERE (((Val(nz([ocupation])))<>-1) AND ((nz([email]))<>""))
ORDER BY cust_list.wsort, cust_list.numw;

Name: qmail_list_insw
SQL:
INSERT INTO tb_email ( qemail )
SELECT nz([email]) AS qemail
FROM cust_list
WHERE (((nz([email]))<>"") AND ((Val(nz([ocupation])))<>-1) AND ((cust_list.cleandate) Is Not Null) AND ((DateAdd("m",-1,[cleandate]))<=Date()) AND ((DateAdd("d",+14,[cleandate]))>=Date()) AND ((cust_list.aswb)=False));

Name: qmail_list_inv
SQL:
INSERT INTO tb_email ( qemail )
SELECT nz([email]) AS qemail
FROM cust_list
WHERE (((nz([email]))<>"") AND ((Val(nz([ocupation])))<>-1) AND ((DateAdd("ww",-1,[insdate]))<=Date()) AND ((cust_list.swd)=False));

Name: qmail_sapak
SQL:
SELECT SAPAKIM.[SHEM SAPAK], SAPAKIM.EMAIL
FROM SAPAKIM
WHERE (((SAPAKIM.[SHEM SAPAK]) Is Not Null) AND ((SAPAKIM.EMAIL) Is Not Null))
ORDER BY SAPAKIM.[SHEM SAPAK];

Name: qmail_sapak_old
SQL:
SELECT SAPAKIM.EMAIL, SAPAKIM.[SHEM SAPAK]
FROM (orders INNER JOIN tb_catalog ON orders.ob_comp = tb_catalog.hevra) INNER JOIN SAPAKIM ON tb_catalog.sapak = SAPAKIM.[CODE SAPAK]
GROUP BY orders.rnum, SAPAKIM.EMAIL,SAPAKIM.[SHEM SAPAK]
HAVING (((orders.rnum)=[Forms]![person_orders_list]![rnum]));
UNION ALL SELECT SAPAKIM.EMAIL, SAPAKIM.[SHEM SAPAK]
FROM (orders INNER JOIN tb_catalog ON orders.ob_comp2 = tb_catalog.hevra) INNER JOIN SAPAKIM ON tb_catalog.sapak = SAPAKIM.[CODE SAPAK]
GROUP BY orders.rnum, SAPAKIM.EMAIL,SAPAKIM.[SHEM SAPAK]
HAVING (((orders.rnum)=[Forms]![person_orders_list]![rnum]));
UNION ALL SELECT SAPAKIM.EMAIL, SAPAKIM.[SHEM SAPAK]
FROM (orders INNER JOIN tb_ad_catalog ON orders.ocomp = tb_ad_catalog.hevra) INNER JOIN SAPAKIM ON tb_ad_catalog.sapak = SAPAKIM.[CODE SAPAK]
GROUP BY orders.rnum, SAPAKIM.EMAIL,SAPAKIM.[SHEM SAPAK]
HAVING (((orders.rnum)=[Forms]![person_orders_list]![rnum]));
UNION ALL SELECT SAPAKIM.EMAIL, SAPAKIM.[SHEM SAPAK]
FROM (orders INNER JOIN tb_ad_catalog ON orders.ocomp2 = tb_ad_catalog.hevra) INNER JOIN SAPAKIM ON tb_ad_catalog.sapak = SAPAKIM.[CODE SAPAK]
GROUP BY orders.rnum, SAPAKIM.EMAIL,SAPAKIM.[SHEM SAPAK]
HAVING (((orders.rnum)=[Forms]![person_orders_list]![rnum]));
